adoption.scope: Existing E150 adoption evidence remains separate; this fixed-source diagnostic authorizes no kernel replacement.

parameter_tuning.scope: No additional profile, row-size or lookup sweeps on this frozen prototype.

major_research.scope: A complete supply/lifetime change must include the impact on all TDMA/register consumers and whole FFN. No additive span or promised speedup.

limitations: Six run/cluster observations share one allocation, not six independent repetitions.
Endpoint summaries are medians; their differences are not medians of per-run differences. Interval metrics use paired endpoints in the same cluster clock.
Spans include waits and overlap and are not exclusive service or savings. No elapsed spans are summed.
Only E150 has internal traces in this allocation. Historical E147 internal traces are not contemporaneous controls.
Whole/info/trace use different host process scopes. This fixed diagnostic is not an additional adoption performance allocation.
A readiness boundary does not by itself identify a pure bus stall or guarantee that changing one producer advances final completion.
